We are always interested in curious people who want to compute chemistry at surfaces. Even when no call is listed below, feel free to send a CV and a short motivation letter to surfreact@upol.cz.

Ph.D. position — modelling electrocatalytic interfaces

Placeholder posting — edit or remove.

We seek a Ph.D. student to develop and apply machine-learned potentials for metal–electrolyte interfaces. You should hold (or be about to finish) an M.Sc. in chemistry, physics, or a related field, and enjoy both scripting and thinking about mechanisms.

What we offer: full funding, access to national HPC resources (Karolina, LUMI), international collaborations, and a friendly group in one of the nicest historical cities in Czechia.

How to apply: email a CV, transcript, and contact for one reference to surfreact@upol.cz.

M.Sc. and bachelor projects

Topics in adsorption thermodynamics, reaction path finding, and microkinetics are available every semester for students of Palacký University. Stop by the department or write to us.
